rules: Every signal flows through the EventBus. No side channels.
The Sentinel returns only ALLOW, BLOCK, or ESCALATE.
Validators are bouncers, not thinkers. They check; they never decide policy.
Charter rules are loaded once and never mutated at runtime.
Handler failures are logged. The bus never crashes.
State transitions are rigid. Illegal transitions raise.
Retries use exponential backoff: wait = 2^retry_count * base_interval.
Nothing outbound without an ALLOW verdict.
